import socket

def resp(f):
    line = f.readline().strip()
    t, rest = line[:1], line[1:]
    if t == b'$':
        n = int(rest); d = f.read(n); f.read(2); return d
    raise Exception(line)

def dump(port, key):
    s = socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', port)); f = s.makefile('rb')
    s.sendall(f"*2\r\n$4\r\nDUMP\r\n${len(key)}\r\n{key}\r\n".encode())
    d = resp(f); s.close(); return d

# CRC-64-JONES (redis variant, reflected poly 0x95AC9329AC4BC9B5, init 0, xorout 0)
poly = 0x95AC9329AC4BC9B5
tbl = []
for i in range(256):
    c = i
    for _ in range(8):
        c = (c >> 1) ^ poly if c & 1 else c >> 1
    tbl.append(c)

def crc64_jones(data, crc=0):
    for b in data:
        crc = (crc >> 8) ^ tbl[(crc ^ b) & 0xFF]
    return crc

def crc64_jones_initff(data, crc=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF):
    for b in data:
        crc = (crc >> 8) ^ tbl[(crc ^ b) & 0xFF]
    return crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

    c1 = crc64_jones_initff(pl)
    print(name, 'payload-crc jones(init0)  =', c0.to_bytes(8,'little').hex())
    print(name, 'payload-crc jones(initff) =', c1.to_bytes(8,'little').hex())
    print(name, 'raw tail =', payload[142:].hex())

import socket, re

class C:
    def __init__(self, port):
        self.s = socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', port))
        self.f = self.s.makefile('rb')
    def cmd(self, *args):
        out = b'*%d\r\n' % len(args)
        for a in args:
            if not isinstance(a, bytes): a = str(a).encode()
            out += b'$%d\r\n%s\r\n' % (len(a), a)
        self.s.sendall(out)
        return self.read()
    def read(self):
        line = self.f.readline()
        t, rest = line[:1], line[1:].strip()
        if t in (b'+', b'-'): return rest.decode()
        if t == b':': return int(rest)
        if t == b'$':
            n = int(rest)
            if n == -1: return None
            d = self.f.read(n); self.f.read(2); return d
        if t == b'*':
            n = int(rest)
            if n == -1: return None
            return [self.read() for _ in range(n)]
        raise Exception(line)
